LanguageData.Rimverse_StartFailedText: The starting ship could not be built, so your people woke up on the ground. Your cargo is here and unlocked. You can still build a ship and launch later.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterRumor: Traders and intercepted signals talk about a civilization {0}. Nobody knows its name or what it wants. Scan more stars, travel or trade to find out more.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CivRumorInfo: All you have is a rumor: someone is out there, {0}. Scan their stars, meet their ships or trade with their neighbours to learn more.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CivMoreIntel: More details appear as you learn about them: contact, trade, treaties, scans and time spent in their space.
LanguageData.Rimverse_HudFoodTip: Edible food stored on this map, divided among {0} colonists.
LanguageData.Rimverse_HudPowerTip: Stored: {0} Wd of {1} Wd. The bar shows how full the batteries are.
LanguageData.Rimverse_HudOnlyShip: Ship panel only on ship maps
LanguageData.Rimverse_HudOnlyShip_Desc: Hide the status panel on maps without a Rimverse ship.
LanguageData.Rimverse_HudOffset_Desc: Moves the panel down from the top right corner, for example to sit below RimHUD or other panels.
LanguageData.Rimverse_OutpostNeedColonists: The caravan needs at least {0} colonists.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyChapterGeneric: The team finished this stage of the study. Send them back to continue.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyInfo: Anomalies are found when a body is scanned in detail. Study them with a ship in the system, or with a colony for digs.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyNeedColony: Needs one of your colonies in this system.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyNeedPresence: Needs your ship or a colony in this system.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyRewards: Rewards: {0} research, {1} silver to the treasury, {2} influence, plus any items listed.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ClaimNeedIntel: You need to know this civilization better (Known level).
LanguageData.Rimverse_ColonySurfaceCollect: Surface outpost: send a caravan there to collect goods.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CouncilBusy: A vote is already under way.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CouncilNone: The galactic council forms once you know at least three civilizations that are willing to talk.
LanguageData.Rimverse_CouncilProposal: On the floor: {0} · vote in {1} days
LanguageData.Rimverse_EmpireFirstGov: Choose how your realm is run. The first choice is free.
LanguageData.Rimverse_EmpireReformInfo: A reform costs {0} influence and can be done once per year.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FacilityMax: Already at the limit for this colony.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FacilityNeedTier: The colony must be a {0} first.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FacilitySurfaceOnly: Only for outposts on a planet surface.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FederationNone: No federation yet. Found one with an ally (60 influence).
LanguageData.Rimverse_FleetBattleChoice: {0} has engaged {1}. Your ship is in the system: command the battle yourself, or let the admirals resolve it?
LanguageData.Rimverse_FleetCannotReach: The fleet cannot reach that system.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FleetDisbandConfirm: Disband {0}? The ships are scrapped with no refund.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FleetLine: Power {0} · ground {1} · speed {2} ly/day · condition {3} · upkeep {4}/quadrum · mission: {5}
LanguageData.Rimverse_FleetNoShipyard: Needs a shipyard: a colony with a shipyard, or your ship in the system.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FleetNone: No fleets yet. Create one at a shipyard.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FleetNotAtWar: You are not at war with {0}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FleetResultCapital: The capital held out. Take its other worlds first.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FleetResultCaptured: {0} is now one of your colonies.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FleetResultNoGround: Not enough ground troops to take the planet ({0} of {1}).
LanguageData.Rimverse_FleetResultNoPlanet: There was no settled world to take here.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FleetMissionDesc_Defend: protect your colonies in the system
LanguageData.Rimverse_FleetMissionDesc_Capture: take a world, needs ground troops
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterCoalition: Your realm has grown too strong for comfort. {1} civilizations have drawn closer together, and {0} has declared war on you.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterCouncil: The galactic council will vote on: {0}.\n\nThe vote closes in {1} days. Lobby for or against it in the Empire tab.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterFleetDefeat: {0} was beaten by {1} at {2}. The survivors fall back.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterFleetUnpaid: The treasury could not pay {0} silver of fleet upkeep. The crews are unhappy and the ships fall into disrepair.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterVassalRevolt: {0} has thrown off your rule and taken up arms.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterWarDeclared: You are now at war with {0}. War goal: {1}.
LanguageData.Rimverse_ManageCaptured: Recently conquered: stability is lower for a while.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgAllyDefense: {0} will help defend your colonies for a year.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgAllyNoFleet: {0} agreed, but has no fleet free right now.
LanguageData.Rimverse_MsgFleetLost: {0} has no ships left and was dissolved.
LanguageData.Rimverse_OutpostAbandonConfirm: Abandon {0}? Its settlers join this caravan and the outpost is gone for good.
LanguageData.Rimverse_OutpostAbandonDesc: Bring the settlers back into this caravan and abandon the outpost.
LanguageData.Rimverse_OutpostCollectDesc: Load everything the outpost produced into this caravan.
LanguageData.Rimverse_OutpostFoundDesc: Leave some colonists here to found an outpost of your realm. It grows, produces and pays income on its own. Costs {0} steel from the caravan.
LanguageData.Rimverse_OutpostInfo: Choose who stays. Costs {0} steel. At least {1} settlers.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PeaceTermsConquest: {0} claimed worlds are handed over to you.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PeaceTermsHumiliation: They are humiliated. You gain 40 influence.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PeaceTermsLost: You lost the war. You pay {0} silver and lose influence.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PeaceTermsVassal: They become your vassal and pay tribute every quadrum.
LanguageData.Rimverse_PeaceTermsWhite: A white peace: nothing changes hands.
LanguageData.Rimverse_Request_Defense: Defend my colonies for a year ({0} influence, {1} opinion)
LanguageData.Rimverse_RequestLowOpinion: Their opinion of you is too low.
LanguageData.Rimverse_RequestNeedAlly: Needs an alliance (supplies: a trade agreement).
LanguageData.Rimverse_RequestNoWar: You are not at war with anyone.
LanguageData.Rimverse_TitheDesc_Silver: more silver, no goods, a bit less stability
LanguageData.Rimverse_TitheDesc_Food: feeds the people: more growth and stability, less silver
LanguageData.Rimverse_WarConfirm: Declare war on {0}? Their allies will think less of you.
LanguageData.Rimverse_WarNeedClaim: Conquest needs at least one claim on them.
LanguageData.Rimverse_LetterFlowAwaken: {PAWN_nameDef} now feels the Great Flow and follows the path of {1}.\n\nNew powers appear among {PAWN_possessive} abilities.
LanguageData.Rimverse_FlowDisabled: The Great Flow is turned off in the settings.
LanguageData.Rimverse_RG_SignalBack: Signal restored. {0} queued posts are being delivered.
LanguageData.Rimverse_RG_AnomalySolved: {0} has finished studying the {1}. Science is proud.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Der: The salvage teams strip the old ship and bring home what still works.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Anc: The message is finally decoded: a star chart from a lost people.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Pre: The deepest hall opens. Fragments of the old machines are carried to the surface.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Cry: The crystals go quiet, leaving pages of notes behind.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Gra: The readings explain a little more about how space bends.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Dar: A single bottle of strange matter is sealed and shipped.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Aba: The old shafts give up their last ore.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Mec: The hive is taken apart before it wakes up.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Imp: The noble's vault is cracked open.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Fro: The sleepers were long dead, but their medicine was not.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Sin: The song is recorded and played across the realm. People love it.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Tim: Years of data in what felt like days.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Ali: Samples of the garden are harvested and studied.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Voi: The signal stops. Whatever sent it has said what it wanted to say.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Los: The archive is copied before its power dies.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Fos: Museums across the realm ask for the bones.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Sha: Haulers drag the richest pieces home.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_War: The scar is drained of warp matter and slowly closes.
LanguageData.Rimverse_AnomalyEnd_Rimverse_Anomaly_Arc: The whisper ends with a gift and a warning nobody understands.
